description: Final verification, git commit all changes to main branch. Create initial commit with the complete CIOS project scaffold.
steps: Run npm run build to verify final build passes
Run npm run lint to verify lint passes
Run npx prisma validate to verify schema is valid
Stage all files with git add -A

Create initial commit: git commit -m 'feat: initialize Carbon Intelligence Operating System (CIOS) - Next.js 15 with App Router, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS - 88+ model Prisma schema covering all 18 CIOS modules - 7-level org hierarchy: Organization > BusinessUnit > Facility > Building > ProductionLine > Equipment > EmissionSource - Full GHG accounting: Scope 1/2/3 with all 15 Scope 3 categories - Rules Engine, Data Lineage, Explainable AI subsystems - 22+ page routes for all modules - Collapsible sidebar with 4 navigation sections - Supabase auth middleware - shadcn/ui component library'
Verify commit was created successfully with git log --oneline
acceptance_criteria: All files are committed to main branch
Commit message clearly describes the initial project scaffold
Build, lint, and prisma validate all pass before commit
